description: This file contains unit tests for various TUI functions and components, testing behavior such as command parsing, state resolution, session key computation, agent ID inference, error handling, and shutdown safety mechanisms.

methods.name: resolveFinalAssistantText
methods.description: Resolves the final assistant text based on the provided streamed, final, or error message.

methods.name: parseCommand
methods.description: Parses a slash command string into its command name and arguments.

methods.name: getSlashCommands
methods.description: Returns the list of slash commands available.

methods.name: resolveTuiSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves the TUI session key based on scope, raw input, and current context.

methods.name: resolveInitialTuiAgentId
methods.description: Determines the initial agent ID based on configuration, current working directory, and user input.

methods.name: resolveGatewayDisconnectState
methods.description: Provides status and guidance based on the disconnect reason from the gateway.

methods.name: createBackspaceDeduper
methods.description: Creates a deduplication function for backspace events within a specified window.

methods.name: resolveCtrlCAction
methods.description: Determines the action in response to a Ctrl+C event based on timing and input state.

methods.name: isIgnorableTuiStopError
methods.description: Checks if a stop error, such as an EBADF error from setRawMode, can be safely ignored.

methods.name: stopTuiSafely
methods.description: Safely stops the TUI process, ignoring ignorable errors.

ctags.name: state
ctags.pattern: /^    const state = resolveGatewayDisconnectState("gateway closed (1008): pairing required");$/
